notes.title: Legend of Krigz - RoadMap
notes.content:
[h2][b]Roadmap 2026 + First Update[/b][/h2][p]Recruiters,[/p][p]We’re excited to share the [b]classified development roadmap[/b] for 2026. This timeline will guide you through the upcoming updates that will prepare [i]Legend of Krigz[/i] for full release.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔹 The Roadmap[/h3][p]The 2026 development cycle is divided into four key operations:[/p][list][*][p][b]Ops Console Update (Q1)[/b] – UI Overhaul, Co-Op Prep, Cutscene Update, Backend Systems[/p][/*][*][p][b]Operational Zone Expansion (Q2)[/b] – Terrain updates, expanded boundaries, NPC preparation[/p][/*][*][p][b]Operation Readiness (Q3)[/b] – Final polish, performance, and stability for full release[/p][/*][*][p][b]Field Tactics Update (Q4)[/b] – World systems expansion: vehicles, weapons, agents, workshop[/p][/*][*][p][b]Operation Dawn (Late Q4)[/b] – Full release milestone[/p][/*][/list][p]📌 You can view the full roadmap here:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528811/095a9e099280dc5fbc51d56bbced1070af517532.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔹 First Update: Ops Console Update (0.2.0)[/h3][p]Rolling out in [b]Q1 2026[/b], this update focuses on overhauling the game’s core interface and preparing for future co-op integration.[/p][h3]Included in this update:[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528811/56d18c89e054310c1492b7a49988b7c72a8241dd.png"][/img][/p][p]This marks the first step toward building the systems and stability required for full release later in the year.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔹 Looking Ahead[/h3][p]Each update is designed to [b]lay the foundation for the next phase[/b], preparing the terrain, systems, and features before we launch the full version of [i]Legend of Krigz[/i].[/p][hr][/hr]

notes.title: DEMO - Update - 0.1.4
notes.content:
[i]Dear Recruiters,
Due to unforeseen circumstances, updates have been held back for a few weeks. However, we are back and working away.
During our time away, we have been working on refining the UI and making sure the Audio works as planned. We have had some issues reported to us about Audio not working correctly so we have gone back to fix this.[/i]

[h3]Small Patches:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Audio not saving and/or breaking when clicking Apply
[*] Overhauled the Agent Select menu
[/list]

notes.title: DEMO - Update - 0.1.3
notes.content:
[i]Dear Recruiters,
We are sorry that Audio settings were not in the first build. There were some technical issues that had to be sorted out but hopefully now, they should be working. Any issues, please use the in-game feature on the Main Menu.[/i]

[h1]New Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added Save and Loading. If you encounter issues with this, please report them using the in-game report feature located on the main menu.
[*] Added Volume Settings.
[/list]

[h3]Major Patches:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Large Blue House back door had no collision for the player.
[*] Fixed Desk in small house Safe Room did not allow large battery to be picked up.
[*] Fixed rapidly pressing Apply in Main Menu Settings made the screen flicker.
[*] Fixed pressing Cancel in Main Menu Settings right after Applying Settings made the game unresponsive.
[*] Fixed Ambient sound cutting out when in certain parts of the map.
[*] Fixed Krigz snap rotating.
[/list]

[h3]Small Patches:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed cooking sound still stopped playing when moving back to cooker.
[*] Fixed Krigz getting stuck inside Gas Station while patrolling.
[*] Fixed Gas Station desk had collision problems.
[*] Fixed pressing Pause and then Continue made to Pause Menu pop up again.
[/list]

[h3]Reworks:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Road to Transformer/Power Station has been updated with new objects blocking the road.
[*] Safe rooms now include a cooker.
[*] Reloading whether crouching or standing no longer makes noise to attract Krigz.
[*] Vehicles have been resized to the correct proportion to the player.
[*] Sliders on Settings have been redesigned.
[*] Apply button on Pause Menu Settings have been redesigned.
[/list]

[h2]What saves and what doesn't:[/h2]
There's quite a lot of objects within this open world which would make Saving and loading take a long time if each individual item was Saved and Loaded. So to keep loading and saving time to an absolute minimum, world objects such as generators and lights states are not saved.

To keep clarity, Legend of Krigz will be made with object permanence at the forefront which will mean much longer Saving and Loading screens. The Demo will not have object permanence.

There are still some things that are planned to be saved in the future such as crafting, but as we expand some mechanics it can be quite difficult to keep up with fixing issues. So for now, if you plan to craft traps, please do so or you will lose all progress on the crafting.

notes.title: Legend of Krigz Demo Launches This Friday – 25th!
notes.content:
[h1]Prepare yourself — the [i]Legend of Krigz[/i] demo arrives this [b]Friday the 25th[/b].
[/h1]
Step into a world where the line between predator and prey shifts the moment night falls. In this early look at the game, you’ll get a chance to explore the following:

🔦 [h2][b]Survival Tools[/b][/h2]
- Flare Gun: Light up wide areas without making a sound. Limited, but powerful.
- Exploding Barrels: Use them to damage Krigz — or yourself, if you're careless.
- Radios: Distractions that lure Krigz away... if timed right.
- Traps: Deploy them strategically, but beware — Krigz can trap you too.
- Cooking System: Collect food cans and prepare meals at your base.
- Hunger & Stamina: If you don’t eat, you won’t run far.

🌌 [h2][b]World Design[/b][/h2]
- Krigz only hunts at night. Daylight is short — plan wisely.
- Dynamic rain and fog keep every evening tense.
- A demo-sized slice of the full open world, packed with content.

🧠 [h2][b]AI Intelligence[/b][/h2]
- Krigz adapts to your every move.
- He hides in the dark, waiting for you to slip up.
- He will stalk you from beyond your vision range.

⚠️ [i]Note:[/i] Saving is not yet available in this demo build. Progress will reset when you quit the game.

🎮 Add [i]Legend of Krigz[/i] to your wishlist and get ready to enter the fog this Friday.
